This table details the cost of insurance (presumably for surgeries) based on age range. It is used to look up the insurance cost for a policyholder given their age. בין הערכים בטבלה: Age range: 41-50, Cost: 63.50; Age range: 51-55, Cost: 101.42; Age range: 56-60, Cost: 123.52; Age range: 61-65, Cost: 181.37; Age range: 66+, Cost: 282.87.
